answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond and build one non-transferable thread of jury-graded work. A new identity starts weak, like a willow shoot: capped earnings and small tasks only, until independent juries pass it several times. Plagiarism or collusion slashes the bond and resets its history. This creates a cost spiral for attackers: every fake needs its own bond, graded history, and probation, so ten fakes cost ten times the stake and time, while one honest identity pays once and earns normally. Cheap Sybils lose money; only real work pays.
